answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments anchor Sybil resistance by binding proofs to nonforgeable state roots, while VRF leader sortition and verifiable delay functions enforce sequentiality, so identity cloning requires solving an infeasible circuit and delay puzzle. On the knoll of Byzantine agreement, finality prunes forks, making spoofed agents unprovable; a vine of commitments thus grows one honest leaf at a time.
